grammar.pattern: 本来 / 才 / 曾经 / 从来 / 赶紧 / 赶快 / 立刻 / 连忙 / 始终 / 已 / 早已
grammar.purpose: Distinguish event time, quick response and prior expectations
grammar.explanation: 本来 presents an original situation or intention that may contrast with now. 曾经 marks a past experience, not a current habit. 从来没… means never up to the reference time; 从来都… can describe a consistent habit. 才知道 here is only then realizing, unlike 才两个 quantity limitation. 赶紧/赶快 urge prompt action, 立刻 means immediately, 连忙 a prompt response to circumstances. 始终 throughout covers a period. 已 is concise written 已经; 早已 emphasizes completion long before now.

examples.zh: 本来想明天问，今天才知道她已经到了。
examples.py: běn lái xiǎng míng tiān wèn , jīn tiān cái zhī dào tā yǐ jīng dào le .
examples.en: Originally meant to ask tomorrow; only today learned she had arrived.

examples.zh: 发现地址错了，我连忙联系她。
examples.py: fā xiàn dì zhǐ cuò le , wǒ lián máng lián xì tā .
examples.en: On finding the wrong address, I hurriedly contacted her.

examples.zh: 她曾经住这里，旧店早已搬走。
examples.py: tā céng jīng zhù zhè lǐ , jiù diàn zǎo yǐ bān zǒu .
examples.en: She once lived here; the old shop moved long ago.

commonMistakes.wrong: 她曾经住这里，所以现在一定住这里。
commonMistakes.right: 她曾经住这里，现在要再确认。
commonMistakes.why: Past experience does not prove the present situation.

grammar.purpose: Anchor a continuing situation after a past starting point
grammar.explanation: 自从毕业，我们很少见面 establishes graduation as the starting point for infrequent meetings. The following clause supplies the subsequent situation; 自从 alone does not explain why it occurred. 自从她搬走以后 can include 以后. Do not use future 明天 as an already established past starting point.

examples.zh: 自从毕业，我们很少见面。
examples.py: zì cóng bì yè , wǒ men hěn shǎo jiàn miàn .
examples.en: Since graduation we have rarely met.

examples.zh: 自从她搬走以后，我们通过几次电话。
examples.py: zì cóng tā bān zǒu yǐ hòu , wǒ men tōng guò jǐ cì diàn huà .
examples.en: Since she moved away, we have had several phone calls.

examples.zh: 自从年初见过一次，至今还没再见。
examples.py: zì cóng nián chū jiàn guò yī cì , zhì jīn hái méi zài jiàn .
examples.en: Since meeting once at year-start, we have not met again yet.

commonMistakes.wrong: 自从明天毕业，我们过去没见面。
commonMistakes.right: 自从去年毕业，我们很少见面。
commonMistakes.why: Align the established starting event and later situation.

lines.zh: 你还记得从前那家书店吗？
lines.py: nǐ hái jì de cóng qián nà jiā shū diàn ma ?
lines.en: Do you remember that old bookshop?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 记得，我们放学以后常去。
lines.py: jì de , wǒ men fàng xué yǐ hòu cháng qù .
lines.en: Yes. We used to go after school.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 今天想不想去看看？
lines.py: jīn tiān xiǎng bù xiǎng qù kàn kàn ?
lines.en: Shall we have a look today?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 想。不过它年初就搬走了。
lines.py: xiǎng . bù guò tā nián chū jiù bān zǒu le .
lines.en: Yes. But it moved at the beginning of the year.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 啊，我还准备往老地方走。
lines.py: a , wǒ hái zhǔn bèi wǎng lǎo dì fāng zǒu .
lines.en: Oh, I was about to go to the old place.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 新地址在地铁站旁边，我发给你。
lines.py: xīn dì zhǐ zài dì tiě zhàn páng biān , wǒ fā gěi nǐ .
lines.en: The new address is by the metro station. I'll send it.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 收到了。那我立刻出门。
lines.py: shōu dào le . nà wǒ lì kè chū mén .
lines.en: Got it. I'll leave right away.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 别急，我还在找钥匙。
lines.py: bié jí , wǒ hái zài zhǎo yào shi .
lines.en: Don't rush. I'm still looking for my keys.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你每次放钥匙的地方都不一样。
lines.py: nǐ měi cì fàng yào shi de dì fāng dōu bù yī yàng .
lines.en: You put your keys somewhere different every time.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 找到了，在昨天那件外套里。
lines.py: zhǎo dào le , zài zuó tiān nà jiàn wài tào lǐ .
lines.en: Found them, in yesterday's coat.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那三点在书店门口见？
lines.py: nà sān diǎn zài shū diàn mén kǒu jiàn ?
lines.en: At the bookshop entrance at three, then?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好。今天先看书，别又只聊一个下午。
lines.py: hǎo . jīn tiān xiān kàn shū , bié yòu zhǐ liáo yī gè xià wǔ .
lines.en: Yes. Let's actually look at books today instead of just chatting all afternoon again.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: An old address in a new message
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 我曾经住在学校旁边，放学后常去街角的书店。后来搬家了，几年没回去，那家店的地址却一直留在手机里。
lines.py: wǒ céng jīng zhù zài xué xiào páng biān , fàng xué hòu cháng qù jiē jiǎo de shū diàn . hòu lái bān jiā le , jǐ nián méi huí qù , nà jiā diàn de dì zhǐ què yì zhí liú zài shǒu jī lǐ .
lines.en: I once lived by the school and often visited the bookshop on the corner after class. I moved away and hadn't returned for years, but kept its address on my phone.

lines.zh: 今天我和陈宇约好去看看。我本来想去老地方，他告诉我，书店年初已经搬到地铁站旁边。我赶紧改了地址。
lines.py: jīn tiān wǒ hé chén yǔ yuē hǎo qù kàn kàn . wǒ běn lái xiǎng qù lǎo dì fāng , tā gào sù wǒ , shū diàn nián chū yǐ jīng bān dào dì tiě zhàn páng biān . wǒ gǎn jǐn gǎi le dì zhǐ .
lines.en: Today Chen Yu and I arranged a visit. I'd planned to go to the old place, but he told me the shop had moved by the metro at the beginning of the year. I quickly changed the address.

lines.zh: 三点，我们在新店门口见面。门口的字还是从前那几个，里面却大多了，窗边多了两张桌子，可以坐着读书。
lines.py: sān diǎn , wǒ men zài xīn diàn mén kǒu jiàn miàn . mén kǒu de zì hái shi cóng qián nà jǐ gè , lǐ miàn què dà duō le , chuāng biān duō le liǎng zhāng zhuō zi , kě yǐ zuò zhe dú shū .
lines.en: We met outside the new shop at three. The sign still had the same words, but inside it was much bigger, with two new tables by the window for reading.

lines.zh: 老板认出了陈宇，问他最近忙不忙。陈宇说，忙，不过经过这里就会进来。我站在旁边，突然觉得几年过去了，好像也没那么久。
lines.py: lǎo bǎn rèn chū le chén yǔ , wèn tā zuì jìn máng bù máng . chén yǔ shuō , máng , bù guò jīng guò zhè lǐ jiù huì jìn lái . wǒ zhàn zài páng biān , tū rán jué de jǐ nián guò qù le , hǎo xiàng yě méi nà me jiǔ .
lines.en: The owner recognised Chen Yu and asked if he'd been busy. Yes, he said, but he always dropped in when passing. Standing beside him, I suddenly felt those years hadn't been so long.

lines.zh: 我在书架上找到以前读过的一本小说。陈宇说封面早已换了，我打开一看，第一句话还是一样，连当初画的那条线都想起来了。
lines.py: wǒ zài shū jià shàng zhǎo dào yǐ qián dú guò de yī běn xiǎo shuō . chén yǔ shuō fēng miàn zǎo yǐ huàn le , wǒ dǎ kāi yī kàn , dì yī jù huà hái shi yī yàng , lián dāng chū huà de nà tiáo xiàn dōu xiǎng qǐ lái le .
lines.en: I found a novel I'd read before. Chen Yu said the cover had changed long ago. Inside, the first sentence was the same, and I even remembered the line I'd underlined.

lines.zh: 回家时我们各买了一本书。陈宇说，这次总算不是光聊天。我说，聊也聊了，书也买了，下次还能继续。
lines.py: huí jiā shí wǒ men gè mǎi le yī běn shū . chén yǔ shuō , zhè cì zǒng suàn bù shì guāng liáo tiān . wǒ shuō , liáo yě liáo le , shū yě mǎi le , xià cì hái néng jì xù .
lines.en: We each bought a book before leaving. Chen Yu said we'd finally done more than chat. We'd chatted and bought books, I said; next time we could do both again.

choices: A familiar shop in a new place brings back memories
They cannot find the new shop
questions.answer: A familiar shop in a new place brings back memories

questions.q: What does the familiar first sentence bring back?
choices: A memory of underlining the old book
questions.answer: A memory of underlining the old book

lines.py: nà běn xiǎo shuō nǐ yǐ qián kàn guò .
lines.en: You've read that novel before.
lines.speaker: a

lines.py: wǒ zhī dào , kě shì jiù de zhǎo bù dào le .
lines.en: I know, but I can't find my old copy.

lines.py: shuō bù dìng zài nǐ zuó tiān de wài tào lǐ .

lines.py: wài tào néng fàng yào shi , fàng bù xià yī běn shū .

lines.py: nà nǐ xià cì mǎi jiàn dà de .
lines.en: Buy a bigger coat next time, then.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我还是整理书架吧。
lines.py: wǒ hái shi zhěng lǐ shū jià ba .
lines.en: I think I'll organise the bookshelf instead.
lines.speaker: b

extraReadings.title: An old bookshop’s new address: words in context
extraReadings.blurb: Independent everyday examples; these are separate situations.
extraReadings.purpose: Understand each word in a different situation.

lines.zh: 我本来想走路，后来下雨了。
lines.py: wǒ běn lái xiǎng zǒu lù , hòu lái xià yǔ le .
lines.en: I'd planned to walk, but then it rained.

lines.zh: 这本书本来就在我包里。
lines.py: zhè běn shū běn lái jiù zài wǒ bāo lǐ .
lines.en: This book was in my bag all along.

lines.zh: 我曾经在这条街上住过。
lines.py: wǒ céng jīng zài zhè tiáo jiē shàng zhù guò .
lines.en: I once lived on this street.

lines.zh: 她曾经教过我弹钢琴。
lines.py: tā céng jīng jiào guò wǒ tán gāng qín .
lines.en: She taught me piano once.

lines.zh: 我从来没来过这家店。
lines.py: wǒ cóng lái méi lái guò zhè jiā diàn .
lines.en: I've never been to this shop.

lines.zh: 他从来不吃辣的。
lines.py: tā cóng lái bù chī là de .
lines.en: He never eats spicy food.

lines.zh: 车来了，赶紧走吧。
lines.py: chē lái le , gǎn jǐn zǒu ba .
lines.en: The bus is here. Let's hurry.

lines.zh: 赶紧把窗户关上，雨进来了。
lines.py: gǎn jǐn bǎ chuāng hù guān shang , yǔ jìn lái le .
lines.en: Quick, close the window; rain's coming in.

lines.zh: 快八点了，赶快起床。
lines.py: kuài bā diǎn le , gǎn kuài qǐ chuáng .
lines.en: It's almost eight. Get up quickly.

lines.zh: 汤要凉了，赶快喝。
lines.py: tāng yào liáng le , gǎn kuài hē .
lines.en: The soup will get cold. Drink it while it's hot.

lines.zh: 她听见门铃，立刻去开门。
lines.py: tā tīng jiàn mén líng , lì kè qù kāi mén .
lines.en: She heard the doorbell and went straight to open the door.

lines.zh: 收到地址，我立刻出发。
lines.py: shōu dào dì zhǐ , wǒ lì kè chū fā .
lines.en: I'll leave as soon as I get the address.

lines.zh: 杯子倒了，我连忙拿纸擦。
lines.py: bēi zi dào le , wǒ lián máng ná zhǐ cā .
lines.en: The cup tipped over and I quickly grabbed paper to wipe it up.

lines.zh: 看到朋友进来，他连忙站起来。
lines.py: kàn dào péng you jìn lái , tā lián máng zhàn qǐ lái .
lines.en: He hurriedly stood up when he saw his friend come in.

lines.zh: 比赛的时候，她始终没有放弃。
lines.py: bǐ sài de shí hou , tā shǐ zhōng méi yǒu fàng qì .
lines.en: She never gave up throughout the competition.

lines.zh: 那张照片始终放在他的桌上。
lines.py: nà zhāng zhào piān shǐ zhōng fàng zài tā de zhuō shàng .
lines.en: That photo has stayed on his desk all this time.

lines.zh: 您的订单已收到。
lines.py: nín de dìng dān yǐ shōu dào .
lines.en: Your order has been received.

lines.zh: 通知上写着活动已取消。
lines.py: tōng zhī shàng xiě zhe huó dòng yǐ qǔ xiāo .
lines.en: The notice says the event has been cancelled.

lines.zh: 电影早已开始了，快进去吧。
lines.py: diàn yǐng zǎo yǐ kāi shǐ le , kuài jìn qù ba .
lines.en: The film started ages ago. Go in quickly.

lines.zh: 这件事我早已忘了。
lines.py: zhè jiàn shì wǒ zǎo yǐ wàng le .
lines.en: I'd forgotten about that long ago.

lines.zh: 自从搬家以后，我每天坐地铁。
lines.py: zì cóng bān jiā yǐ hòu , wǒ měi tiān zuò dì tiě .
lines.en: Since moving, I've taken the metro every day.

lines.zh: 自从那次见面，我们常常联系。
lines.py: zì cóng nà cì jiàn miàn , wǒ men cháng cháng lián xì .
lines.en: We've kept in touch often since that meeting.

lines.zh: 从前这儿有一家书店。
lines.py: cóng qián zhèr yǒu yī jiā shū diàn .
lines.en: There used to be a bookshop here.

lines.zh: 奶奶喜欢讲从前的事。
lines.py: nǎi nai xǐ huān jiǎng cóng qián de shì .
lines.en: Grandma likes talking about the old days.

lines.zh: 过去我不爱喝茶，现在每天喝。
lines.py: guò qù wǒ bù ài hē chá , xiàn zài měi tiān hē .
lines.en: I used not to like tea; now I drink it every day.

lines.zh: 我们聊了一会儿过去的生活。
lines.py: wǒ men liáo le yī huì er guò qù de shēng huó .
lines.en: We talked about our lives in the past for a while.

lines.zh: 当初怎么想到搬来这里？
lines.py: dāng chū zěn me xiǎng dào bān lái zhè lǐ ?
lines.en: What made you decide to move here in the first place?

lines.zh: 当初买这辆车的时候，它还是新的。
lines.py: dāng chū mǎi zhè liàng chē de shí hou , tā hái shi xīn de .
lines.en: This car was new when I first bought it.

lines.zh: 那件外套我至今还留着。
lines.py: nà jiàn wài tào wǒ zhì jīn hái liú zhe .
lines.en: I still have that coat to this day.

lines.zh: 他至今没有回复那封信。
lines.py: tā zhì jīn méi yǒu huí fù nà fēng xìn .
lines.en: He still hasn't replied to that letter.

lines.zh: 这张照片是哪个年代的？
lines.py: zhè zhāng zhào piān shì nǎ gè nián dài de ?
lines.en: What era is this photo from?

lines.zh: 我喜欢看八十年代的电影。
lines.py: wǒ xǐ huān kàn bā shí nián dài de diàn yǐng .
lines.en: I like watching films from the eighties.

lines.zh: 年初我买了一辆自行车。
lines.py: nián chū wǒ mǎi le yī liàng zì xíng chē .
lines.en: I bought a bicycle at the beginning of the year.

lines.zh: 我们年初约好了夏天见面。
lines.py: wǒ men nián chū yuē hǎo le xià tiān jiàn miàn .
lines.en: We arranged at the beginning of the year to meet in summer.

lines.zh: 我年底准备回家。
lines.py: wǒ nián dǐ zhǔn bèi huí jiā .
lines.en: I'm planning to go home at the end of the year.

lines.zh: 这家店到年底就开了十年了。
lines.py: zhè jiā diàn dào nián dǐ jiù kāi le shí nián le .
lines.en: This shop will have been open for ten years by the end of the year.

lines.zh: 这条街变化很大。
lines.py: zhè tiáo jiē biàn huà hěn dà .
lines.en: This street has changed a lot.

lines.zh: 天气有变化，记得带外套。
lines.py: tiān qì yǒu biàn huà , jì de dài wài tào .
lines.en: The weather's changing. Remember a coat.

lines.zh: 旧教室变为了一间阅览室。
lines.py: jiù jiào shì biàn wéi le yī jiān yuè lǎn shì .
lines.en: The old classroom became a reading room.

lines.zh: 水慢慢变为了冰。
lines.py: shuǐ màn màn biàn wéi le bīng .
lines.en: The water gradually turned to ice.

lines.zh: 我在这个小城里成长。
lines.py: wǒ zài zhè gè xiǎo chéng lǐ chéng zhǎng .
lines.en: I grew up in this small town.

lines.zh: 看着孩子成长，她很高兴。
lines.py: kàn zhe hái zi chéng zhǎng , tā hěn gāo xìng .
lines.en: She's happy watching her child grow up.

lines.zh: 我对那家店的印象很好。
lines.py: wǒ duì nà jiā diàn de yìn xiàng hěn hǎo .
lines.en: I have a good impression of that shop.

lines.zh: 这首歌给我留下了很深的印象。
lines.py: zhè shǒu gē gěi wǒ liú xià le hěn shēn de yìn xiàng .
lines.en: This song made a deep impression on me.

audio.zh: 新地址在地铁站旁边，我发给你。
audio.py: xīn dì zhǐ zài dì tiě zhàn páng biān , wǒ fā gěi nǐ .
audio.en: The new address is by the metro station. I'll send it.

tasks.statement: The new address is by the metro.
tasks.why: This fact is explicitly stated in the heard line.

audio.zh: 回家时我们各买了一本书。陈宇说，这次总算不是光聊天。我说，聊也聊了，书也买了，下次还能继续。
audio.py: huí jiā shí wǒ men gè mǎi le yī běn shū . chén yǔ shuō , zhè cì zǒng suàn bù shì guāng liáo tiān . wǒ shuō , liáo yě liáo le , shū yě mǎi le , xià cì hái néng jì xù .
audio.en: We each bought a book before leaving. Chen Yu said we'd finally done more than chat. We'd chatted and bought books, I said; next time we could do both again.

tasks.statement: The friends leave without buying any books.
tasks.why: The heard line explicitly describes a different action.

AI-assisted draft; native review pending. GF2021 grammar families: 三14, 三21. Native check: adverb family 本来/才/曾经/从来/赶紧/赶快/立刻/连忙/始终/已/早已, written 已 register, 自从 time anchoring, and economical verse phrasing. No inferred current residence or confirmed future meeting. Native review pending. Planned retrieval 三06 / 三46 / 三12 / 三58: 文件打得开，日期还没核对。, 找了十分钟，终于找到了。, 今天更加清楚，不等于一定更快。, 不比她快，可能一样快。.
2026-10-07 parity editorial review: Naturalness correction: last two tickets for a Saturday show, returning to a relocated bookshop, a twenty-minute riverside walk after three meetings, and shared rehearsal with water-break teasing. Removed assessment-rule monologues and inflated coverage recycling from dialogue and readings. All 88 word records retain IDs and receive two independent contexts. Self-review: Saturday show at seven, third row and twenty-yuan tickets; bookshop moved at beginning of year, meet at three; walk twenty minutes, no running; Lin An sings first and Chen Yu second, no solo performance. False statements contradict their own heard clip. Existing grammar ownership and assessment IDs retained. Native flags: written register 仅/已/变为/至今, 空 kōng versus kòng, informal 有的是, habitual 往往 versus 总是, 采取/采用, 成果/成就, and teasing about bringing one’s head. Native review pending. Native review pending; no independent pronunciation or learner-mastery certification.
2026-10-09 keys follow-through: everyday 每次…都不一样 replaces an affirmative 从来 sentence in the friendly bookshop exchange; 从来 retains its independent vocabulary contexts. Old unit, word and task IDs are preserved. Fresh audio and full gates required. Native review pending.
